test_title: PYST 8: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. B sits second to the right of A. G sits second to the right of B. C is the immediate neighbour of E and G. D sits second to the right of E. How many people sit between F and E when counted from the left of E?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) B sits second to the right of A.

2) G sits second to the right of B.

3) C is the immediate neighbour of E and G.

4) D sits second to the right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aae203be2d2e5f38dc71bbe8662ee65bd674cea5f5f99f81b64cdd7d146b0190.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c42219acc7b14ffdbf52431b00f31288b882afff712819f7177fc940881de4d.png] 

So, F will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1dbb27be642bfe7e23f21a3df186a527b2a89f4c0e97fc359a2ab5c57a451f5e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00bca950fd19ffef477d872c7638ead93dedeba947b33f7886fe40d45ef887e4.png] 

Here, There are people sit between F and E when counted from the left of E

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
